14:00.race_name: Wynnstay Mares' "National Hunt" Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Struggled since returning from a long absence and she now has a basement mark
runners.name: Fine As Wine
runners.spotlight: Irish point form was very respectable but she has struggled since returning from a long absence and now has a basement mark.

runners.comment: Ran well for an 80-1 chance when beaten under 10l behind an odds-on favourite at Taunton
runners.name: Geordies Betty
runners.spotlight: Ran well for an 80-1 chance when beaten under 10l behind an odds-on favourite at Taunton and she handles these conditions; shouldn't be far away.

runners.comment: Clear second behind a Skelton favourite at Uttoxeter; should be very competitive here
runners.name: Halftheworldaway
runners.spotlight: Bought for 130,000euros after finishing second in an Irish point; clear second behind a Skelton favourite at Uttoxeter a month ago (2m, soft) and should be very competitive in this company.

runners.comment: Showed something on debut in Ireland but produced a lesser performance next time
runners.name: Iamyouare
runners.spotlight: Made a fair debut in Ireland (2m3f maiden) but failed to build on that at Bellewstown in July (again on good ground); probably up against it on British debut.

runners.comment: One of the favourites when not beaten far into third in a mares' maiden point in Ireland
runners.name: Longhouse Gem
runners.spotlight: One of the favourites when not beaten far into third in a mares' maiden point in Ireland in December (soft); joined a good yard for rules action and kicks off in a modest contest; tongue-tie added.

runners.comment: Modest form when narrowly beaten in a Hexham bumper; tailed off on hurdle/stable debut
runners.name: Looks Matter
runners.spotlight: Modest form when narrowly beaten in a Hexham bumper for previous yard and was tailed off on debut for this one in a 2m maiden hurdle at Sligo.

runners.comment: 500-1 when pulled up on her belated debut in a recent maiden hurdle at Uttoxeter (soft)
runners.name: Seekingrainbows
runners.owner: S L Edwards & S A Hollinshead
runners.spotlight: 500-1 when pulled up on her belated debut in a recent maiden hurdle at Uttoxeter (soft).

runners.comment: Third in a point bumper; opposable on what she's shown in a bumper and maiden hurdle
runners.name: Shouldvebeenshav
runners.spotlight: Third in a point bumper; opposable on what she's shown in a bumper and maiden hurdle.

runners.comment: No closer than 15l for current yard; handicapping the last twice; some chance here
runners.name: Ufouria
runners.spotlight: Won an Irish bumper in early 2025; no closer than 15l in three runs for current yard, the last two handicaps (2m; good to soft/heavy); could still have a say in this weak a race.

runners.comment: Beaten about 10l in an Irish point and the winner has landed a bumper for Gavin Cromwell
runners.name: Vale Of Tears
runners.spotlight: Beaten about 10l in an Irish point last April and the winner has landed a bumper for Gavin Cromwell; this mare should have a future under rules but is probably one for further down the line.

runners.comment: Won two bumpers and easily off the mark over hurdles last time at Doncaster
runners.name: Count Of Vendome
runners.spotlight: Won two bumpers and also ran well in a Listed race at Cheltenham; narrowly denied on his hurdle debut here (soft) but comfortably went one better as an odds-on chance at Doncaster (good to soft); talented and going the right way.

runners.comment: Badly interfered with when favourite for a Class 3 handicap at Windsor last time
runners.name: Harry Lowes
runners.spotlight: Point/novice winner; beaten favourite in a Class 3 handicap at Windsor last time but did meet with significant interference as the race was hotting up; big shout in a race of this nature.

runners.comment: Improved plenty for the fitting of a tongue-tie when a willing winner at Ffos Las (heavy)
runners.name: The Hawkstonian
runners.spotlight: Improved plenty for the fitting of a tongue-tie when a willing winner at Ffos Las (2m, heavy) and highly likely that he has a lot more to offer.

runners.comment: Has quite a bit to find on the figures and looks the stable second string
runners.name: Ayyadieh
runners.spotlight: Well held in both Irish points last spring and same story in two hurdle runs (2m1f/1m7f) this winter; has quite a bit to find on the figures and looks the stable second string.

runners.comment: Struggled in bumpers and same story when 28-1 for recent hurdle debut at Southwell
runners.name: Good Boy Griff
runners.spotlight: Struggled in bumpers and same story when 28-1 for recent hurdle debut at Southwell (2m, good to soft); has the least convincing claims.

15:00.race_name: Legend, The Mogul, Chris Rowe Handicap Hurdle

runners.comment: Has won all the handicaps he's contested, from 2m1f to 3m on all sorts of ground
runners.name: Mask Of Zorro
runners.spotlight: Has won all the handicaps he's contested, from 2m1f to 3m on all sorts of ground; he's had a 6lb rise since his hard-fought win at Doncaster but the in-form Rian Corcoran claims 7lb; hard to knock.

runners.comment: On a losing run but ran well enough for a long way in Class 2 handicap at Chepstow latest
runners.name: Classic Concorde
runners.spotlight: Veteran who is on a losing run but ran well enough for a long way in a Class 2 handicap at Chepstow two months ago (2m7f, good to soft) to command respect at this lower level; goes well on this ground.

runners.comment: Maiden winner; able off this sort of mark but may need good ground to show his form
runners.name: Manowest
runners.spotlight: Won his maiden over this trip at Worcester last May and has since shown he can cope with this sort of mark; whether he'll cope with today's ground is another matter as his best form has been on good.

runners.comment: Game winner off 4lb lower at Newcastle and can improve for this longer distance
runners.name: Twistthenightaway
runners.owner: Mrs Paul Shanahan & Mrs John Magnier
runners.spotlight: Defied market weakness to make a winning handicap debut at Newcastle (2m4f, heavy) and the runner-up had won the time before; her finishing effort that day would suggest that this trip should be within reach; raised 4lb.

runners.breeder: R D & Mrs J S Chugg
runners.comment: He's struggled back over hurdles following a break and wind surgery
runners.name: Galassian
runners.spotlight: Won a maiden hurdle here last season but chasing halted his progress and he's struggled back over hurdles following a break and wind surgery; now goes in cheekpieces; risky.

15:30.race_name: Wrexham Lager "Chasing Excellence" Novices' Chase (GBB Race)

runners.comment: This looks a good opportunity after chasing home Steel Ally in the Grade 2 Kingmaker
runners.name: Mirabad
runners.spotlight: Surprise winner of his first chase start in December; has bumped into smart opposition since, last time running as well as could have been hoped behind Steel Ally in the Grade 2 Kingmaker at Warwick (2m, heavy); this looks a good opportunity.

runners.comment: As when tailed off at Newbury last week, these terms aren't favourable
runners.name: Leading Choice
runners.spotlight: Very lightly raced 9yo who has won a bumper and a 2m4f maiden hurdle; he was in last throughout in a three-runner novice chase last week at Newbury when returning from 13 months off; as was the case then, these terms aren't favourable.

runners.comment: Chasing debutant who stays 3m and looks vulnerable against Mirabad at this trip
runners.name: Titan Discovery
runners.spotlight: Ran rather flat in a good Sandown handicap last time but won a Class 2 the time before at Cheltenham (3m, good to soft), his fourth win over hurdles; once had the pace for this trip but may need further now ideally, so will do well to lower the colours of Mirabad.

16:00.race_name: Alfa Aggregates Products North Wales National Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Running well at present and stays this far, which ticks a big box
runners.name: Jacks Parrot
runners.spotlight: Only his second run of the season when beaten 10l in the Tommy Whittle at Haydock (3m1f, soft) and might have won at Ludlow last week had his jumping been a bit sharper late on; stays this far and that also ticks a big box; blinkers replace cheekpieces.

runners.comment: Had a complete off-day at Wincanton last month and blinkers now replace cheekpieces
runners.name: Pimlico Point
runners.spotlight: Handicapped to be competitive and he'll go on the ground, but he had a complete off-day at Wincanton last month and blinkers now replace cheekpieces.

runners.comment: Windsor last time was disappointing but not all horses take to that track
runners.name: De Legislator
runners.spotlight: 2-5 over fences and an assured stayer having finished a 5l-third over 4m at Kelso in December; Windsor last time was disappointing but not all horses take to that track.

runners.comment: Has been beaten 16l and 14l in two handicaps at about 4m the last twice
runners.name: Bodhisattva
runners.spotlight: Without a win since May 2023 and has been beaten 16l and 14l in two handicaps at about 4m the last twice; he was behind a couple of these on one of those occasions.

runners.comment: Below par latest but has the form and attributes to feature in a race of this nature
runners.name: Betterforeveryone
runners.spotlight: Has won over 4m so did well to win over 3m here (good; has won on soft) in October when only 2lb lower; comfortably held since at Uttoxeter (3m2f) but has the form and attributes to feature in a race of this nature.

runners.comment: 2lb higher than when second over 4m at Kelso, which was just about a career best
runners.name: Breeze Of Wind
runners.spotlight: Strong stayer who was 6lb out of the weights when runner-up in the Scottish Borders National at Kelso in December (De Legislator 3l adrift); 2lb higher now but this is just his sort of race.

runners.comment: Consistent but perhaps doesn't win as often as she should
runners.name: Lagonda
runners.spotlight: Third over 3m1f at Hereford last time (soft; first-time cheekpieces), making the frame in that handicap for the second successive season; consistent but perhaps doesn't win as often as she should (1-15 over fences and runner-up five times); unraced beyond about 3m1f.

runners.comment: 0-7 over fences but has been running well; possible stamina limitations over this far
runners.name: Astronomic View
runners.spotlight: 0-7 over fences but has been running well, not beaten at all far the last twice in races at about 3m; however, although a 3m2f winner over hurdles, 3m6f appeared too far at Exeter in December.

runners.breeder: Ecurie Nicolas Taudon & M Joel Poitou
runners.comment: 0-14 in this discipline and came up short in a veterans' chase a month ago
runners.name: Gold Emery
runners.spotlight: A runner-up on six occasions over fences but 0-14 in this discipline and came up short in a veterans' chase a month ago (3m1f); looks vulnerable.

runners.comment: Well handicapped on old form but has pulled up the last twice on the back of long absences
runners.name: Bali Body
runners.spotlight: Well handicapped on old form but has pulled up the last twice on the back of long absences; new trainer fits a tongue-tie.

runners.comment: Not firing on all cylinders this season but too well handicapped to ignore
runners.name: Planned Paradise
runners.spotlight: Beaten 16l at Windsor last time (3m4f) in a race he won the previous year off a 9lb higher mark than today's; not firing on all cylinders this season but too well handicapped to ignore.

16:30.race_name: Nightingale House Hospice Novices' Handicap Chase

runners.comment: His third run back from a mammoth absence when chasing home an improver at Catterick
runners.name: Jiair Madrik
runners.spotlight: His third run back from a mammoth absence when chasing home an improver at Catterick last month (1m7f, soft; tongue-tie returned); won't be far away with a repeat performance.

runners.comment: Bled last time and it has been a positive start for his current yard; respected
runners.name: Carrigmoorna Rowan
runners.spotlight: Became disappointing for Harry Fry but has performed respectably over hurdles and fences for current yard; bled when he failed to give his running last time in a handicap chase; won't mind returning to this trip.

runners.breeder: David Lumet & Dr V Catherine Lumet
runners.comment: Good third at Ludlow before getting stuck in the mud (heavy) at Taunton
runners.name: Jaitroplaclasse
runners.spotlight: Gave good account when close third in first-time cheekpieces at Ludlow (2m4f, good to soft) last month and perhaps not helped by the heavy ground when a beaten favourite next time; only 1-12 as a chaser but he's in the mix.

runners.comment: Returned to fences at Hereford two weeks ago and looked booked for second when falling
runners.name: Copper Cove
runners.spotlight: Bumper/hurdle winner who goes well on slow ground; he returned to fences at Hereford two weeks ago and looked booked for second when falling late on; has a chance off 1lb lower.

runners.comment: Twice uncompetitive in handicap hurdles before departing mid-race on chase debut
runners.name: Just Aidan
runners.spotlight: Two wins over hurdles; showed nothing in that discipline on his return from a break and unseated mid-race on chase debut three weeks ago; too risky.

runners.comment: Nowhere near his best over hurdles this season and not bred for fences
runners.name: Port Or Starboard
runners.spotlight: Placed lots of times over hurdles but won only once in 24 attempts; hasn't been close to his best this season and he's not bred for fences.

runners.comment: Still a maiden and hasn't offered all that much in three runs following a break
runners.name: Daring Plan
runners.owner: Miss Jane Edgar & D V Gardner
runners.spotlight: Still a maiden and hasn't offered all that much in three runs following a break, as the third was quite remote; tries cheekpieces.

runners.comment: Hasn't got a lot going in his previous chases but well handicapped on some hurdle form
runners.name: Catboy
runners.spotlight: Hasn't got a lot going in his previous four chases but well handicapped on some of his hurdle form and didn't run too badly in that discipline last time.

17:00.race_name: Tom Jones Live At Chester Racecourse Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners.comment: On a useful mark and his yard is in better form now than when he ran at Christmas
runners.name: Galop De Chasse
runners.spotlight: Became inconsistent last season and his good record fresh makes his comeback run at Chepstow over Christmas all the more disappointing; still, he's on a useful mark and his yard is in better form now.

runners.comment: Chase winner last March; two lesser runs have come on either side of wind surgery
runners.name: Ostend
runners.owner: Jamie Rock A Lewis M Howell & Partner
runners.spotlight: Won a four-runner chase at Market Rasen (2m3f, good) in March; two lesser runs have come on either side of wind surgery and there are some doubts about him on soft ground.

runners.breeder: Brittas House Stud And Grenane House
runners.comment: Inconsistent but a repeat of his second at Southwell in Dec would give him every chance
runners.name: Bowenspark
runners.spotlight: Useful bumper horse and hurdler but has always struggled with consistency, a pattern that's threatening to continue over fences; however, if in the same form as when second to a sharp improver at Southwell two runs back (2m4f, good to soft; fine on soft) he'd have every chance.

runners.comment: 2-3 over fences; could now be on tough mark but should still run well
runners.name: Kykorock
runners.spotlight: Has improved for fences, winning back-to-back handicaps (2m, soft; 2m1f, good to soft) before a respectable third in a higher grade than this at Haydock; could now be on a tough mark but can still run well over a trip he should stay fine.

runners.comment: Open to improvement as a chaser and fitness might not be an issue given yard he represents
runners.name: Casual Observer
runners.owner: Noel Fehily Racing Syndicate - Casual Ob
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced and career-best form in winning a 2m4f handicap hurdle at Ffos Las (heavy) when last seen 12 months ago; looks on a realistic mark for chase debut and he was second in an Irish point; fitness might not be an issue given the yard he represents.

13:50.race_name: Happy 18th Birthday James Dunford Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Runner-up on last two starts despite racing freely; Cobden takes over; sets the standard
runners.name: Aguellid
runners.spotlight: Solid third on stable debut in November and he built on that in two starts last month, prominent in the market when second at Hereford (soft; first-time hood) and over C&D (heavy); still needs to settle better but leading claims again with Harry Cobden taking over.

runners.comment: Can't be fancied on his two starts over hurdles, most recently when 150-1 and pulled up
runners.name: Anthracite
runners.spotlight: Can't be fancied judged on his two starts over hurdles, most recently when 150-1 and pulled up over C&D last month.

runners.comment: 52,000euros 3yo from family of Harbour Pilot; fair efforts in points; market helpful
runners.name: Are You Joking
runners.spotlight: 52,000euros 3yo from the family of high-class staying chaser Harbour Pilot; just fair efforts when third and fourth in Irish points last spring; market can help on this rules/stable debut.

runners.comment: 6th over C&D (heavy; 6-1) 11 days ago; that was a first start for 355 days so may improve
runners.name: Full Force Gale
runners.spotlight: Won Ffos Las bumper (good to soft) in October 2024 and he was back with this yard when sixth over C&D (heavy; 6-1) 11 days ago; that was his first start for 355 days so not inconceivable he builds on it.

runners.comment: Modest in two bumpers but has hurdlers in the family so could show more in this sphere
runners.name: Governors Island
runners.spotlight: Two starts in bumpers; beaten 50l in a good event at Newbury in November and weakened again when seventh of 11 at Exeter (also good to soft) last month; plenty of hurdlers in the family and will probably do better in this sphere.

runners.comment: Dual Flat winner (moderate form) and makes little appeal on his hurdling/stable debut
runners.name: Hawa Jumeirah
runners.spotlight: 2-19 on the Flat, those moderate wins coming over 1m4f (AW) and 1m2f (good to firm) last year; hurdles/stable debut on this forecast ground will be a very different ball game.

runners.comment: Hints of ability in bumpers; has joined an upwardly mobile yard for this hurdling debut
runners.name: King Berry
runners.spotlight: Hints of ability in three bumper starts for Ed de Giles last year; mixed messages on pedigree for hurdling but makes his debut in this sphere for a yard that has announced itself this term; market might help.

runners.comment: Drifted when well-held hurdles 3rd for this yard in May; market a help on first run since
runners.name: Lemon Leaf
runners.spotlight: Soundly beaten in three Irish points last year but belied 80-1 odds when fourth of 12 in Naas bumper (good to yielding) on rules debut in December 2024; 100-30 from 2-1 for hurdles/stable debut when third of sixth at Aintree (2m1f, good; beaten 18l) in May; interesting to see what the market makes of him on this first start since.

runners.comment: Chased home a good one last time; nothing of that calibre here; leading contender
runners.name: Loustic Du Chatel
runners.spotlight: Won a farcical five-runner bumper at Ascot in November; first-time hood when running moderately over hurdles at Newbury the following month but did better with that aid removed when an admittedly well-held second at Huntingdon (2m, soft) last month; winner was set to run a big race until falling in Grade 2 on Saturday and this one's best days are ahead of him; player.

runners.comment: Two-year break before encouraging 3rd in December; flopped latest; might bounce back
runners.name: Matthias
runners.spotlight: Came back from two-year absence with encouraging third in Chepstow novice (good to soft) in December; 7-4 from 3-1 but he took a big step backwards when tailed-off last of five finishers at Lingfield (also about 2m3f, heavy) three weeks ago; new tongue-tie/drop in trip might help and he's not confidently ruled out.

runners.comment: Beaten over 30l in two starts over hurdles; tongue-tie added
runners.name: Montrachet Fin
runners.spotlight: Attracted support before finishing down the field on his bumper debut at Fontwell in October and has been beaten over 30l in two starts over hurdles; tongue-tie added.

runners.comment: £3,000 yearling by Jack Hobbs; yard knows the family well; worth a market check on debut
runners.name: Padel Bandit
runners.spotlight: £3,000 yearling by Jack Hobbs; dam unraced half-sister to this yard's winners Violet Dancer (smart 2m hurdle/chase) and Chris Pea Green (useful 2m hurdle/chase); worth a market check on this introduction.

runners.comment: Showed ability in bumpers and pedigree suggests he'll do even better over hurdles
runners.name: Secret Sniper
runners.spotlight: Showed promise in two junior bumpers in 2024 but ran out of puff on his return from 335-day break at Ascot in November; brother to useful hurdler Secret Squirrel from the family of Champion Hurdle runner-up Marble Arch so should have a future at this game.

runners.comment: Won Irish point in November & bought for £48,000 five days later; market check essential
runners.name: Tap Tap Shamie
runners.spotlight: Weakened on his Irish point debut in the spring of 2024 but came back from 560-day break to beat seven others convincingly in November; purchased for £48,000 five days later; market check essential on this stable/hurdles debut.

runners.comment: 150-1 but didn't run badly when fifth a fortnight ago; others probably more likely, though
runners.name: Viva Vincente
runners.spotlight: 150-1 for both starts in heavy-ground hurdle races and he didn't run badly when fifth of 13 at Hereford (2m, heavy) a fortnight ago; others probably more likely, though.

runners.comment: Promise when staying-on sixth at Kempton (2m, good to soft) three weeks ago; contender
runners.name: Ajs Diamond
runners.spotlight: Clear ability in bumpers and she was far from disgraced on second start in this sphere when staying-on sixth of 16 in mares' maiden at Kempton (2m, good to soft) three weeks ago; contender.

runners.comment: Market gave up on her when 80-1 and beaten 40l at Warwick last month
runners.name: Independent Lady
runners.spotlight: Single-figure prices but no fireworks in a bumper and novice last year; market gave up on her when 80-1 and beaten 40l at Warwick last month.

runners.comment: Showed ability in bumpers; plenty of winning jumpers in her pedigree; hurdles debut
runners.name: Midnight Doyen
runners.spotlight: Only fractional improvement in three bumpers but she attracted solid support when fifth of ten here (heavy) last time; plenty of winning jumpers in her pedigree; hurdles debut.

14:20.race_name: WinOlympics Family Day On Sale Now Mares' Handicap Hurdle

runners.breeder: E A R L Haras Du Grand Courgeon
runners.comment: Placed nine times including last two (chases); can hang but cheekpieces go on; big player
runners.name: Plantaroma
runners.spotlight: 0-13 across all disciplines but she's been placed nine times, including when third in both her chases this term (2m, good and soft); often hangs right for pressure but the cheekpieces go on for this return to hurdles and this represents a drop back down in grade; big player.

runners.comment: Latest 4th in Chepstow novice (2m, soft) was a fair effort; could do better now in h'caps
runners.name: Man Maid
runners.spotlight: All starts under Megan Bevan; midfield on her debut in C&D maiden in December and narrowly bettered that form when fourth of ten in Chepstow novice (2m, also soft) on latest start; this handicap debut should see her more competitive.

runners.breeder: Lasnawood Ltd & Tullis Park Rose Ltd
runners.comment: Latest 2nd at Plumpton (2m, soft) arguably makes this opening hurdles mark workable
runners.name: Shalfa
runners.spotlight: Five Flat wins (7f and 1m2f, sound surfaces) at an ordinary level; best of three hurdle runs when second to an odds-on shot at Plumpton (2m, soft) a fortnight ago; that form arguably makes this opening hurdles mark workable; usually wears headgear on Flat and now does so for first time as hurdler.

runners.comment: Down the weights but tailed off last twice; drop in trip/hurdles might help; risky
runners.name: Irisante
runners.owner: Mark E Smith And David Lestrange
runners.spotlight: Opening mark looked harsh but she's tumbled down the weights; hasn't been able to capitalise on that, however, and was tailed off on her chase debut at Wetherby (about 2m3f, soft) in December; drop in trip and return to hurdles might help but she's risky.

runners.comment: Weakening when unseating on stable/h'cap debut 16 days ago; new hood probably no bad thing
runners.name: Adaay Dancing
runners.spotlight: Finished third but beaten 16l in C&D maiden (good) in November on final start for Stuart Kittow; again took a grip and was on the retreat when unseating at Catterick (about 2m, soft; first-time tongue-tie) on stable/handicap debut at Catterick 16 days ago; still early days in this sphere and the incoming hood is probably not a bad idea.

runners.comment: Close second in November; excuse latest; freshened up since and she can't be ruled out
runners.name: Little Venice
runners.spotlight: Went mighty close at Leicester (soft) in November despite pulling hard and her trainer blamed three fairly quick runs when she disappointed at Uttoxeter (also 2m, heavy) the following month; freshened up since and she can't be ruled out.

runners.comment: Struggled following an absence; well treated and has had wind surgery; tongue-tie goes on
runners.name: Harthill
runners.spotlight: Just her second handicap when she beat 15 others to win at Stratford (2m2f, soft; 50-1) in late 2023; two-year absence followed and she hasn't threatened in two starts this term; 7lb below that winning mark and the tongue-tie goes on following wind surgery but she'd be of interest only with market support.

14:50.race_name: Play Golf At Wincanton Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Fair fourth on his return in December; pulled up latest and he's not easy to predict
runners.name: Nambiti
runners.spotlight: Dual chase winner in France in 2021 (2m1f/2m3f); lightly raced in recent years but best run for this stable when fair fourth at Hereford (3m1f, good to soft) in December on his return from a big absence; pulled up in a similar contest at Warwick last month and it's not easy to know what can be expected despite stable being in better form now.

runners.comment: On the up over fences and won at Doncaster latest; 3lb nudge looks no bother; big player
runners.name: The Long Point
runners.spotlight: Bumper winner in 2024; on the up in three starts over fences and off the mark in four-runner Doncaster handicap (3m, soft; second has won since) one month ago, after which he had wind surgery; 3lb nudge should be no bother and he's a big player.

runners.breeder: S C E A De La Fontaine
runners.comment: Ran well penultimate start but flopped latest; ground a query but respected on chase debut
runners.name: Doctor Midas
runners.spotlight: Chased home one who was on the middle leg of a five-timer in Ascot novice handicap hurdle (about 3m, good to soft) in November but ran poorly in similar event back at that track one month later; same mark for this chase debut and untried on softer than good to soft but he's still respected.

runners.comment: Okay seasonal debut but he was pulled up next time; consistency remains an issue
runners.name: Phantom Getaway
runners.spotlight: 0-10 and essentially disappointing since switched to fences in 2023; he didn't do badly when fourth on seasonal debut at Ffos Las (3m, soft; has gone well there before) in November but pulled up at Chepstow last month and consistency remains an issue.

runners.comment: Four chase wins, including C&D; flopped over fences last time but contender to bounce back
runners.name: West Orchard
runners.spotlight: Won three out of four chases in October-December 2024 (including C&D, good to soft; handles softer) and was an encouraging second over hurdles here (about 3m) on his comeback from a year's absence; return to fences didn't go well at Taunton later that month but could bounce back following two months off.

15:20.race_name: Albert Bartlett Triple Crown Series Handicap Hurdle (Qualifier)

runners.comment: Knocking on the door prior to a comfortable win at Plumpton; solid claims up 6lb
runners.name: Dirty Den
runners.spotlight: Knocking on the door on good ground this season prior to gaining a deserved win at Plumpton (2m4f, soft) recently; 6lb higher in a more competitive race today but he did it comfortably last time and has solid claims.

runners.comment: Returns from absence but makes stable debut with new trainer in fine form; could go well
runners.name: Mammies Boy
runners.spotlight: Made it three wins from his last five starts (2m3f/2m5f, good) when scoring at Warwick last May on final outing for Jonjo and AJ O'Neill; absent since and the forecast slower ground poses a question, but he makes stable debut with new trainer in fine form; could go well in first-time tongue-tie.

runners.comment: Better could have been expected last time but he's lightly raced and not written off
runners.name: Duffry Trixs
runners.spotlight: Won maiden hurdle at Taunton (2m3f, good to soft) last February and returned with a promising third in Lingfield handicap (2m7f, good to soft) in December, when not seeing out the trip; better could have been expected at Huntingdon (2m4f, soft) since but this lightly raced 7yo is not written off.

runners.comment: Bumper winner who has also shown promise over hurdles; possible improver on handicap debut
runners.name: Kiwi Rush
runners.spotlight: 3m point runner-up and soft-ground bumper winner who has also shown promise on all three hurdle starts (2m4f/2m, soft/good); he may be able to take a step forward now going handicapping.

runners.comment: Pulled up on two of his last three runs but good third at Market Rasen in between
runners.name: The Long Walk
runners.spotlight: Pulled up on two of last three runs, so isn't a reliable proposition; however, in between he kept on for a good third at Market Rasen (extended 2m2f, good to soft) and he is of interest on that form, if on a going day.

runners.breeder: Sca La Perigne Ecurie Du Chene Roger-Y
runners.comment: Lightly raced 5yo who was runner-up over C&D last month and that form reads well
runners.name: Le Soleil Reve
runners.spotlight: Won 4yo hurdle at Hereford (2m, soft) last February on second start and he's been runner-up in both handicaps, most recently over C&D (soft) last month; that latest form reads well and he's a strong contender up 3lb.

runners.comment: 0-15 over hurdles but on a reduced mark and the Harry Cobden booking catches the eye
runners.name: Bright Legend
runners.spotlight: 0-15 over hurdles and needs to produce more than he's managed this term; however, his reduced mark appeals on his useful form up to last March and Harry Cobden is 4-9 this season for Faye Bramley, whose stable is in good form; no surprise to see a bold show now back in a handicap.

runners.comment: Returned from break with a pretty encouraging run at Huntingdon and could build on it
runners.name: Escapologist
runners.spotlight: Good-ground maiden hurdle winner who has dropped down the weights across his four previous handicap starts; last month's fourth of 15 at Huntingdon (2m4f, soft) was a pretty good effort on his first outing since last May and he could build on it this afternoon.

runners.comment: Won in Jersey in 2024 on sole hurdle start; tough tasks over fences this season
runners.name: Mini Mildred
runners.spotlight: Four Flat wins in a row prior to completing five-timer on hurdle debut in Jersey in June 2024; following a long absence she's been handed some tough tasks this season in her first three chases, and she has far more realistic claims now in a handicap on her second hurdle start; interesting.

runners.comment: Consistent in short career and pedigree suggests he'll improve for the longer trip
runners.name: Hans Lippershey
runners.spotlight: He's not obviously well treated off his opening mark but this 5yo has been consistent across his six starts (all at 2m) and his pedigree provides optimism that he'll improve for the step up in trip; possible player.

runners.comment: Won handicap debut at Doncaster in December and open to further improvement for top yard
runners.name: Laughing John
runners.spotlight: Built upon the promise shown in junior hurdles last year (including on soft ground) when winning on handicap/seasonal debut at Doncaster (2m, good to soft) in December; had just two rivals to beat on that occasion but the form still looks solid and he's open to further improvement for top yard.

runners.comment: Had excuses on last two starts and he has potential off this mark judged on his Flat form
runners.name: Almuhit
runners.spotlight: Merely seventh over hurdles on both runs this year but he may have needed the first outing and heavy ground might not have suited last time; has potential off this mark judged on last year's progressive Flat form and he's not discounted for his in-form stable.

runners.comment: Tailed off latest but could be a contender on h'cap debut if tapping into previous promise
runners.name: Can You Hear Me
runners.spotlight: Tailed off at Hereford (2m3f, good to soft) in December on latest start but prior to that he caught the eye when runner-up in a novice hurdle at Lingfield (2m3f, good to soft); could be a contender on handicap debut if tapping back into the promise shown on that penultimate start.

runners.comment: Very in and out across his light career but some good form this season and not discounted
runners.name: Zainy Champ
runners.owner: I F Gosden And DJ Coles
runners.spotlight: 7yo who has been very in and out across his light career, but he won at Exeter (extended 2m2f, soft) in December and was running well (albeit looking tired) when falling at the final flight at Sandown (2m4f, heavy) last month; not discounted.

runners.comment: Unexposed point winner who could prove to be on a realistic mark for his handicap debut
runners.name: Hello Fortune
runners.spotlight: 3m point winner who has shown ability at Lingfield (2m3f/2m, good to soft-heavy) on his three hurdle starts; this unexposed 6yo could prove to be on a realistic mark for his handicap debut.

15:50.race_name: Cheltenham Preview 5th March At Wincanton Handicap Chase

runners.comment: Won 3-runner chase in May; on the premises when unseating latest; respected
runners.name: Walkinthewoods
runners.spotlight: Landed the odds in three-runner chase at Plumpton (about 2m3f, good; acts on soft/heavy) in May; solid hurdles second under Osian Radford in December and still on the premises when blundering that rider away over fences (also Ludlow, 3m, good to soft) last month; drops back down in trip; respected.

runners.comment: Two wins here (including C&D); disappointed latest but could bounce back at this venue
runners.name: Flash Gorcombe
runners.spotlight: Dual winner here (including C&D) who was second in this in 2024; built on seasonal debut when third over C&D (soft) in December but jumped right and disappointed at Exeter last time; contender to bounce back returned to this venue.

runners.comment: Returned to form over hurdles latest (heavy); interesting contender on this chase debut
runners.name: Whatmakes Honey B
runners.spotlight: Experienced pointer who won a Taunton handicap hurdle (2m3f, good) off 1lb higher in March; returned to form when fourth over that C&D (heavy) three weeks ago; could be interesting on this chase debut under rules.

runners.comment: Has won here (2m, heavy); showed more when 2nd latest and may be rediscovering his level
runners.name: Hatos
runners.spotlight: Won back to back on heavy ground around this time two years ago, latterly at this track (about 2m) off an 18lb higher mark; winless since but ran like he might be rediscovering his level when a keeping-on second at Fontwell (about 2m3f, soft; third has won since) last month; considered.

runners.comment: Has won after a 182-day break; soft-ground query but could get involved on this comeback
runners.name: My Rockstar
runners.spotlight: C&D (good) winner in April 2023 who also popped up at Taunton (2m2f, good to soft) in November 2024 following a 182-day break; just four starts since have included two solid efforts and it's possible he can have a say back from a 331-day absence; has a query on soft ground, however.

runners.comment: Pulled up on last two starts; new headgear combination after wind surgery; needs to revive
runners.name: Universal Secret
runners.spotlight: Went close here (about 2m, good to soft) in December 2024 but he's 0-9 over fences and his two runs this term have been troubling; has his first start following wind surgery, with a tongue-tie joining the cheekpieces of latest start; needs a revival.

runners.comment: Fell on his reappearance and hasn't got home in two starts since; question to answer now
runners.name: Jack Doyen
runners.spotlight: Dual chase winner around this trip (soft) who has dipped below his last winning mark; fell at Southwell on November's reappearance and hasn't got home in two starts (2m5f, good to soft and heavy) since; question to answer at present.

runners.comment: Solid second on penultimate start but disappointed next time; soft-ground query too
runners.name: Constant Friday
runners.spotlight: Good-ground hurdle winner off a much higher mark before a big absence; it's been a long road back but he didn't give up the ghost at Lingfield (good to soft) on penultimate start; disappointed over that C&D (soft) last month, though, and needs to prove he can operate on this forecast soft ground.

runners.comment: No rules form to speak of for this yard; 25-1 and beaten 24l in a point nearly a year ago
runners.name: Sans Of Gold
runners.spotlight: No rules form to speak of for this yard; 25-1 and beaten 24l in a point for Nikki Frost when last seen nearly a year ago; out of the weights.

16:20.race_name: Pointing Pointers Dick And Sue Woodhouse Memorial Hunters' Chase (For The Dick Woodhouse Trophy)

runners.comment: Useful for Dan Skelton but looks regressive judged on his recent pointing exploits
runners.name: Beat Box
runners.spotlight: Useful handicapper for Dan Skelton but looks regressive judged on his recent pointing exploits.

runners.comment: May need a longer trip now (last run at 3m1f) but strong claims otherwise
runners.name: Thunder Rock
runners.spotlight: Powers were on the decline when confined to hurdling last season but he was a classy chaser back in the day and nearly won his first hunter chase over 3m1f here a month ago (heavy); may need that longer trip now but strong claims otherwise.

runners.breeder: Joel Denis & Scea Haras De Saint Voir
runners.comment: Dual chase winner but looks very vulnerable on these terms
runners.name: Gateau De Miel
runners.spotlight: Won a handicap at Stratford last summer on debut for Barry Brennan but was tailed off on final run for that yard and has now returned to his former trainer; looks very vulnerable on these terms.

runners.comment: Now needs to bounce back from two non-completions and cheekpieces are turned to
runners.name: Mr Glass
runners.spotlight: Won a hunter chase here in January 2025 but was pulled up in the same race a month ago when Thunder Rock was second; now needs to bounce back from two non-completions and cheekpieces are turned to.

runners.comment: Second to the smart Unexpected Party at Taunton and that was after a wind operation
runners.name: Fan De Blues
runners.spotlight: Very useful when trained in Ireland by Willie Mullins; kicked off for this yard after a long absence but ran well in that race at Taunton (2m5f, good) after wind surgery, finishing best of the rest behind the smart Unexpected Party; enters the reckoning.

runners.comment: Found some form in points last spring but this is a belated debut over regulation fences
runners.name: Gig In The Park
runners.spotlight: Found some form in points last spring but this is a belated debut over regulation fences and he probably wants drier ground.

16:50.race_name: Wincanton Fillies' "Junior" National Hunt Flat Race (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Half-sister to two bumper winners and was second on Doncaster debut in November; respected
runners.name: Ashburton
runners.spotlight: £25,000 3yo; half-sister to two bumper winners and she was a well-backed favourite when a rallying second at Doncaster (2m, soft; 100-30) in November; that was a promising start and the form has been boosted by the winner since; respected back from a break.

runners.comment: Yard 1-41 in bumpers in recent years and she could be a longer-term prospect
runners.name: Billey Shiftit
runners.spotlight: Eighth foal; half-sister to winners My Lady Grey (3m2f hurdle/chase) and So Said I (2m4f-3m hurdle/chase); dam bumper winner, half-sister to smart bumper/2m-3m2f hurdle/chase winner Bob Bob Bobbin; yard 1-41 in bumpers in recent years and she could be a longer-term prospect.

runners.comment: Encouraging fourth on C&D debut but was pulled up over hurdles last time; hood added
runners.name: Detroit Bay
runners.spotlight: Made an encouraging start when fourth of 12 over C&D (good) in November but she was pulled up when switched to hurdling at Taunton the following month; slipped at an early stage in the latter race but a hood is now added and she needs improvement back in a bumper.

runners.comment: 1,000euros foal; others look more likely types and she's best watched on debut
runners.name: Diamond Lily
runners.spotlight: 1,000euros foal; second foal; dam well held in a point and 2m3f-2m6f hurdle races, half-sister to useful bumper and 3m-3m2f hurdle/chase winner Station Master; others look more likely types and she is best watched on debut.

runners.comment: 95,000euros 2yo; plenty to like on paper and she needs watching in market on debut
runners.name: Gustes Dance
runners.spotlight: 95,000euros 2yo; half-sister to winners Great Dance (bumper) and Louise Demonmirail (French 2m2f hurdle); dam smart 2m-2m4f hurdle winner, half-sister to winners Sail Away (useful 2m-3m1f hurdle/chase) and Lad Of Luck (bumper); plenty to like on paper and she needs watching in market.

runners.comment: £52,000 3yo; interesting newcomer for top yard and she needs a close look
runners.name: Madam Speaker
runners.spotlight: £52,000 3yo; second foal; sister to bumper winner Chatty Girl; dam French 1m3f winner, half-sister to winners Fivefortwo (1m including 2yo) and Wow William (1m4f), out of maiden half-sister to 1m2f Group 3 winner Buckhurst; interesting newcomer for top yard and she needs a close look.

runners.comment: 50,000euros 3yo; yard 0-16 in bumpers in recent years and she could be one for later on
runners.name: Mysteriosa
runners.spotlight: 4,000euros foal, 50,000euros 3yo; ninth foal; half-sister to winners Lagertha (2m hurdle), Elektrix (French 2m1f/2m2f hurdle), Sindarbueno (French 2m5f chase) and Grand Knight (point); dam 1m7f Flat and 2m2f-2m3f hurdle (including Grade 3) winner; yard 0-16 in bumpers in recent years and she could be one for later on.

runners.comment: £14,000 yearling; yard 15% in bumpers in recent years and market should guide on debut
runners.name: Nathannah
runners.spotlight: £14,000 yearling; fourth foal; dam bumper and 2m2f/2m3f hurdle winner, half-sister to useful winners Carrigmartin (2m-2m5f hurdle/chase) and City Slicker (bumper/2m-2m4f hurdle), out of 2m-2m1f hurdle/chase winner; yard 15% in bumpers in recent years and market should guide on debut.

runners.comment: Has quite a lot of stamina in the pedigree and yard is not known for bumper winners
runners.name: New Virginia
runners.spotlight: 9,000euros yearling; sixth foal; half-sister to French 2m3f hurdle winner Virgule De Teillee; dam dual French 2m3f chase winner, sister to smart 3m-3m3f hurdle/chase winner Ramses De Teille; has quite a lot of stamina in the pedigree and yard is not known for bumper winners.

runners.comment: Sister to a Listed bumper winner and she needs watching in the market on debut
runners.name: Sister Cecilia
runners.spotlight: Sixth foal; sister to Listed bumper and Group-placed 11.4f-1m4f Flat winner Urban Artist (RPR 108), half-sister to winners Our Jester (dual bumper) and Star Artist (2m hurdle); dam Listed bumper and 1m2f-1m4f Flat winner (108); looks the part on paper and yard is 18% in bumpers in recent years.

runners.comment: Well backed when close second at Ludlow and sets standard on that form; key player
runners.name: Steal A Glance
runners.spotlight: Dam (half-sister to high-class chaser Handstands) won five on soft or heavy for the Honeyballs, including a bumper; well backed into 6-1 on Ludlow debut (2m, good to soft) last month and made a bold bid before finishing a close second; sets the standard on that promising effort; yard also runs Ashburton.

runners.comment: 40-1 and finished tailed off on Newbury debut in December; hood removed
runners.name: Subtle Glance
runners.spotlight: 40-1 and finished tailed off at Newbury (2m, good to soft) in December; hood worn on debut is now removed.

runners.comment: This looks a tough starting point and she is probably best watched
runners.name: West Hill Rosie
runners.spotlight: £28,000 yearling, 2,000gns 2yo; fourth foal; half-sister to winners Global Skies (6f 2yo; RPR 87) and Balboa (2m hurdle); dam 7f 2yo/10.4f winner (94), half-sister to winners Behtarini (2m2f hurdle) and Behrama (bumper); this looks a tough starting point and she is probably best watched.

runners.comment: Out of a half-sister to three bumper winners and she needs watching in the market on debut
runners.name: Whodunit
runners.spotlight: First foal; dam unraced half-sister to winners Bitofapauzzle (useful bumper and 2m3f-2m7f hurdle/chase), Golden Gael (bumper/2m-2m3f hurdle) and Magellan Straights (bumper/2m hurdle); yard is in good form and she needs a market check.

13:12.race_name: Midnite Ain't Your Grandad's Bookie Amateur Jockeys' Handicap

runners.breeder: Mrs L N Harmes & Mr M Willis
runners.comment: Well held over hurdles in last two runs but he's on a dangerous mark back on the Flat
runners.name: Fravanco
runners.spotlight: Well held back over hurdles in his two runs this winter but he went close over C&D (off 1lb lower) in final run last summer; could be a big factor if he can recapture that form and both of his wins have been on Polytrack.

runners.comment: Has won three of his last five, including at Wolverhampton (1m6f) last Sunday; key player
runners.name: Knight Of Magic
runners.spotlight: Improver who has won three of his last five starts, including with a strong finish at Wolverhampton (1m6f) last week; has a penalty for that narrow success but he should be unfazed by this drop back in trip and he's effective on Polytrack; leading contender with Simon Walker booked.

runners.comment: Record of 1-20 and he's struggled in last four runs; needs big turnaround in new headgear
runners.name: Versatile
runners.spotlight: Scored off 10lb higher at Bath (1m2f, firm) last May but he's generally struggled since and was always in rear on his reappearance over C&D two weeks ago; that took his record to 1-20 and he needs a big turnaround; first-time visor.

runners.comment: Well held over hurdles in last five runs and sole win was over 1m in September 2024
runners.name: Dynamite Defense
runners.spotlight: Sole win was at Dundalk (1m, AW) in September 2024 and he's been well held in five hurdle runs for current yard; has something to prove back on the Flat and this is competitive; cheekpieces removed.

runners.comment: Had excuse on 1m reappearance last month and this trip is more suitable; not ruled out
runners.name: Charles Morin
runners.spotlight: Some respectable efforts at up to 2m last summer and the drop back to 1m was no good for him on his reappearance here last month; overall record is now 1-19 but he's on a dangerous mark and could get involved on this big step back up in trip.

runners.comment: Eight-time hurdle winner but he's 1-15 on the Flat and has yet to be placed on AW
runners.name: Tara Iti
runners.spotlight: Eight-time hurdle winner but he's 1-15 on the Flat; looks on workable mark back in this sphere but he hasn't fired over hurdles in his last two runs and he's yet to be placed on AW; down the list.

runners.comment: Runner-up in classified events at Wolverhampton last twice; respected back on Polytrack
runners.name: Starfighter
runners.spotlight: Six-time Tapeta winner who has finished runner-up in classified events at Wolverhampton (1m4f) in his last two starts; still looks feasibly treated back in a handicap and he's a big player if he can transfer his form back to Polytrack.

runners.comment: Multiple course winner who has shown some encouraging signs this year; could be in the mix
runners.name: Marions Boy
runners.spotlight: All six wins have been on Polytrack and five have been at Lingfield; lost his way in 2025 but he's shown some encouraging signs in classified events this year, including when third here (1m2f) on his penultimate run; has plenty of form over C&D and he could be dangerous off reduced mark.

runners.comment: In-form filly but she's still a maiden and has stamina to prove back up in trip
runners.name: Summer Evening
runners.spotlight: 0-10 but she's finished close up here in her last three starts, including two handicaps (1m/1m2f); hard to rule out another good run but she still has stamina to prove at this trip and others are more persuasive; tongue-tie added.

runners.comment: 12yo who has not won since 2020 and was well held on his comeback at Leicester in October
runners.name: Broad Appeal
runners.spotlight: 12yo who has not won since 2020 and was well held on his return from a long absence at Leicester (1m4f, soft) in October; back on the sidelines again since and can only watched.

runners.comment: 15-race maiden who flopped at Ffos Las in September; needs a major revival after a break
runners.name: Beaune
runners.spotlight: Went close off this mark at Ffos Las (1m2f, soft) last August but he flopped there in his final run in the autumn; this return to 1m4f should be fine but he's still a maiden after 15 starts and needs a major revival after a break.

runners.comment: Has struggled at big prices in all six starts including two runs for new yard this year
runners.name: Mary Rose
runners.spotlight: Has struggled at big prices in all six starts, including in two runs for new yard this year; cheekpieces are now added and she needs a transformation back up in trip.

13:42.race_name: Always Gamble Responsibly At BetMGM Handicap

runners.comment: Ended 2025 on the up; not fully exposed and he looks a key player back from 12 weeks off
runners.name: Solar Invincible
runners.spotlight: Better for the addition of cheekpieces on his last two starts, second over C&D before a ready Chelmsford success in December; should make another bold bid back from 12 weeks off.

runners.comment: No improvement for handicapping on last two starts; enough to prove for now
runners.name: Mad Dash
runners.spotlight: No improvement for the switch to handicaps on her last two starts; well bred and in good hands but racecourse evidence suggests she is vulnerable.

runners.comment: Has shown winning potential and the new headgear if a possible source of improvement
runners.name: Havana Jag
runners.owner: Hold My Beer D Cunha M Broughton
runners.spotlight: Placed three times in novice company and she has run respectably in both handicaps, third over C&D 18 days ago; needs more to win but the addition of blinkers offers hope of better.

runners.comment: Clear with the 2nd when winning at Southwell 18 days ago; 3lb rise not insurmountable
runners.name: Life After Love
runners.spotlight: It wasn't a strong race that she won at Southwell 18 days ago but she showed a willing attitude and the front two pulled a long way clear of the third; should make another bold bid.

runners.comment: Didn't progress for Jamie Osborne but down in weights & needs a market check on yard debut
runners.name: Jane Of The Jungle
runners.spotlight: Didn't progress after early promise for Jamie Osborne; starts out for her new stable off a reduced mark and worth a market check back from four months off.

runners.comment: Solid record in 5f handicaps; less good over 6f on Saturday; this more suitable
runners.name: Rosieisme Darling
runners.spotlight: Record in 5f handicaps reads 2122 and Saturday's lesser effort over 6f excusable; hard to argue that she was well treated but still likely to give her running.

14:12.race_name: Midnite: Built For 2026 Not 2006 Restricted Novice Stakes (For horses In Bands B, C And D) (GBB)

runners.comment: Gelded after 2yo debut and improved to win on AW 13 days ago (dead-heat); penalty to defy
runners.name: Numero Vingt
runners.spotlight: Some promise amidst inexperience in one turf run as a 2yo, after which he was gelded; stepped forward when dead-heating at Chelmsford two weeks ago (6f) and may do better yet; he will need to progress again to defy a penalty though.

runners.comment: Down the the field in two Polytrack maidens this year; minor handicaps beckon
runners.name: Molly Marine
runners.spotlight: Big prices and towards the rear in two Polytrack maidens this year (7f and 6f), 5.5l behind Numero Vingt 13 days ago; minor handicaps beckon.

runners.comment: Clear promise in two Southwell runs this winter; more needed to win but he can do better
runners.name: Southern Warrior
runners.spotlight: Two Southwell runs around the turn of the year (5f/6f) saw him record an RPR in the 60s; remains capable of better but such progress looks essential.

runners.comment: Modest form in two turf runs over 5f last August; this trip more suitable; can do better
runners.name: Staniel Cay
runners.spotlight: Ran to a modest RPR but showed clear signs of ability in two 5f turf runs last August; more to offer this year and stepping up in trip should prove beneficial.

runners.comment: Fine 3rd on Newbury debut; backward step when 2-5f at Haydock; debut sets clear standard
runners.name: Moonshine
runners.spotlight: Promising start to her career when third of six in a Newbury fillies' maiden (6f, good to firm) last July; absent since a defeat at short odds at Haydock three weeks later (7f, good) but the debut run sets a clear standard in this field; key player.

runners.comment: Second run was better than her debut; hood left off this time; can do better
runners.name: Mayflyer
runners.spotlight: Modest form in two runs last month but the second effort (hooded first time, absent today) was better than the debut and she should continue to improve; she will need a good leap forward to shake up the principals though.

14:42.race_name: Midnite Are Upping The Betting Game Handicap

runners.comment: Chance on his Irish form in late 2025; low-key stable debut but now drops in class
runners.name: Tomarlo
runners.spotlight: Won just one of his 18 starts in Ireland for David Marnane but he was in fair form in the latter part of 2025; low-key stable debut (after a wind op) at Wolverhampton last month; interesting to see if he's stronger in the betting with that behind him and dropped in class.

runners.comment: Drops into his first 0-60 and a big run looks on the cards from a handy draw
runners.name: Honour Your Dreams
runners.spotlight: On a dangerous mark and he was a good third over C&D on his penultimate run; subsequent lesser effort came in a Class 5 and he tackles his first 0-60 today; well drawn and a big run looks on the cards.

runners.comment: 50-1 win here last month has been followed by two lacklustre efforts; not a solid option
runners.name: Manhattan Chute
runners.owner: J May R L Field W Trenchard J Pook
runners.spotlight: Sprung a 50-1 surprise when getting the better of Desdemona over C&D last month; two poor runs have followed and he comes here with plenty to prove; experiment with visor quickly aborted.

runners.comment: Two wins and several good runs in defeat this winter; big player back down in class
runners.name: Street Life
runners.spotlight: Two 5f wins and several good runs in defeat this winter; not at best in a Class 5 at Southwell last time but he rates a strong candidate back down in grade.

runners.comment: Running well enough this winter to enter calculations; not ideally drawn on stable debut
runners.name: Bluebells Boy
runners.spotlight: On a losing run but he comes here in good order, beaten under 2l behind new stablemate Manhattan Chute over C&D five weeks ago; on his fourth different trainer since May (same owner); drawn wider than ideal.

runners.comment: Not at best last time but earlier reappearance was encouraging; not ruled out off low mark
runners.name: Coolagh Magic
runners.owner: Lady Emma Oshea And A Carson
runners.spotlight: Didn't fare badly on his return to action over C&D last month (after a wind op); no progress in a 6f handicap back here 15 days ago but dropped another 3lb since; could be building up to something better.

runners.comment: Arrives on the back of two second-place finishes here (5f and 6f); tough draw this time
runners.name: Desdemona
runners.spotlight: Runner-up in 5f and 6f handicaps here on her last two starts; solid form chance but she will have to do some early running if she is to dominate this field from the outside stall.

runners.comment: Two 0-50 classified wins this year (6f); creditable 4th Tuesday; drop to 5f may not suit
runners.name: Dubai Magic
runners.spotlight: Running well at a low level this winter, getting off the mark in a 6f classified event at Chelmsford last month and adding a Southwell classified win three weeks ago; creditable fourth at Southwell on Tuesday; has run well over 5f in the past but she can blow the start and that could present an issue from stall 2.

runners.comment: Ended losing run at Wolverhampton last week; not discounted despite her 4lb penalty
runners.name: Second Collection
runners.spotlight: She had been threatening prior to last week's come-from-behind win at Wolverhampton (5f); penalty demands a bit more but she should remain competitive.

runners.comment: On the downgrade and, although conditions suit, others have stronger claims
runners.name: The Defiant
runners.spotlight: Not the force of old and, although he retains some ability, others in this field have more pressing claims.

15:12.race_name: Win £250,000 With BetMGM's Golden Goals Handicap (Div I)

runners.comment: Two sound C&D runs for new stable this year; each-way contender
runners.name: Tam Lin
runners.spotlight: 7f win at Chelmsford for Alice Haynes in November; two C&D runs for new stable have both resulted in good efforts but he didn't look straightforward under pressure here two weeks ago.

runners.comment: Finished fast for second over C&D two weeks ago; up 2lb but still more appealing than many
runners.name: Global Warning
runners.spotlight: Veteran who is on a losing run but he was finishing his race off strongly when second over C&D a fortnight ago (Tam Lin third); a 2lb rise doesn't handicap him out of things and he is more appealing than many.

runners.comment: On a losing run but he comes here in good order and holds each-way claims once again
runners.name: Kondratiev Wave
runners.spotlight: On a long losing run but there have been several good efforts this winter, including C&D; each-way claims once more.

runners.comment: Poor form in his three runs but did have a troubled passage here last time; handicap debut
runners.name: Harry Dont Bite
runners.spotlight: Only beaten one rival home in three runs here this year (7f-1m); would have finished closer 18 days ago had he seen any daylight in the home straight but he still arrives with plenty to prove.

runners.comment: Won here (6f) last month; no daylight in the straight at Wolverhampton on Monday
runners.name: Porfin
runners.spotlight: Ready win here (6f) in January; generally held his form since and Monday's low-key effort at Wolverhampton is excusable as he saw no daylight in the home straight.

runners.comment: 1m win here two weeks ago; less good at Chelmsford two days later; now tries cheekpieces
runners.name: Angelica K
runners.spotlight: Made all the running to win a 1m classified event here two weeks ago; not so good at Chelmsford two days later; drops back in trip with cheekpieces given a go; not ruled out.

runners.comment: Second over C&D in December hasn't proved a springboard to better things; risky
runners.name: Roman Emperor
runners.spotlight: Good second over C&D in December but that a rare bright spot in the last few months; others look stronger for win purposes.

runners.comment: On losing run and stamina for 7f has to be taken on trust
runners.name: Miss Moonshine
runners.spotlight: Getting on for two years since the last of her four wins; fair run here last month but it is sandwiched by two heavy defeats (saddle slipped last time); stamina query.

15:42.race_name: Win £250,000 With BetMGM's Golden Goals Handicap (Div II)

runners.comment: 2-26 for Noel Meade; has looked better on turf than AW; not a solid option on stable debut
runners.name: Port Louis
runners.spotlight: The winner of two of his 26 starts for Noel Meade in Ireland; has shown a clear preference for turf over AW but he is handicapped accordingly and starts out for new connections at a modest level; check betting.

runners.comment: 0-15 but down in the weights and this is his first foray into a 0-55; unexposed at 7f
runners.name: Fort Augustus
runners.spotlight: 15-race maiden who has run to a modest level for this yard since November; unexposed at 7f and now dips his toe into 0-55 waters for the first time so can't discount off his much-reduced mark.

runners.comment: Conditions to suit and on a good mark on even this winter's best; one to take seriously
runners.name: Mount Mogan
runners.spotlight: His last four wins have come over C&D; not at his best on his last two starts but he went close over a mile here in November and he races off the same mark today; needs taking seriously.

runners.comment: Poor form for new yard; back up in trip with different headgear given a go
runners.name: Fitzmaurice
runners.spotlight: Poor form in four starts for this yard; steps back up in trip off a reduced mark but it is easy enough to look elsewhere; new visor replaces blinkers here.

runners.comment: Down in weights and latest Class 5 run was more encouraging; interesting down into a 0-55
runners.name: Comedian Leader
runners.spotlight: Struggling for form this winter but she has dropped 16lb since December and her latest sixth (of eight) over 1m here was more encouraging; drops from a Class 5 into a 0-55 and it will be interesting to see if there is any market confidence behind her (started at 33-1+ in last eight runs).

runners.comment: Back to winning ways in a C&D classified event two weeks ago; contender back in a handicap
runners.name: Mintana
runners.spotlight: Got first run on the runner-up when winning a classified event over C&D two weeks ago; 1lb rise shouldn't prevent another big run.

runners.comment: Two best runs this winter have come over C&D; needs more to break her maiden tag
runners.name: Miraflores
runners.spotlight: Her two best efforts this winter have come over C&D but she will need a personal best if she is to make it 13th time lucky.

runners.comment: Down the field in four runs for his current stable; easy enough to swerve
runners.name: The Cola Brasil
runners.spotlight: Down the field in four runs for his current stable and don't need much encouragement to look elsewhere.

16:12.race_name: Read Meg Nicholls' Blog At betmgm.co.uk Classified Stakes

runners.breeder: Glebe Farm Stud & Peter & Ross Doyle
runners.comment: Inconsistent sprinter for former stable; stamina to prove starting out for new connections
runners.name: Back Before Dark
runners.spotlight: Inconsistent for former stable and hasn't added to her maiden win back in June 2023; unraced at further than 7f (tailed off in on attempt) but pedigree offers hope she will stay.

runners.comment: First and second in this grade on last two outings; should be in the thick of it again
runners.name: First Encounter
runners.spotlight: Successful in this grade at Wolverhampton last month (8.6f) and backed it up with a solid C&D second two weeks ago; no obvious reason why he wouldn't be in the thick of the action once again.

runners.comment: Solid course efforts (1m2f) on last two starts; strike-rate of 1-36 is offputting
runners.name: Iftikhaar
runners.spotlight: Chased home Monks Mead in a similar event (1m2f) here last month; another fair effort ten days later and dropping back to a mile shouldn't hinder him; strike-rate of 1-36 does temper enthusiasm though.

runners.comment: Landed gamble on stable debut (1m2f); close 3rd in 9.4f classified at Wolverhampton Monday
runners.name: Man Is King
runners.spotlight: Beaten 41 times in Ireland but he landed a gamble in a 1m2f classified event at Chelmsford on his stable debut this month; well held over 1m4f next time but close third when favourite for a 9.4f classified at Wolverhampton on Monday; in the mix.

runners.comment: Running well in 1m2f classified events in recent weeks; one to consider back at a mile
runners.name: Monks Mead
runners.spotlight: 1m2f win here last month has been followed by good efforts back here and at Chelmsford (behind Man Is King); returning to a mile unlikely to be a problem and he's one to consider.

runners.comment: Second over C&D in a similar race on her British debut 15 days ago, looking a tricky ride
runners.name: Nicely Curved
runners.spotlight: Strong finish to take second in a similar C&D event two weeks ago, her first run in Britain; a repeat would see her on the premises but she didn't look a straightforward ride.

runners.comment: Not stood much racing in recent seasons; needs to step up on this winter's form
runners.name: Pyrrhic Dancer
runners.spotlight: Over two years since his last win but he has only had seven runs (three over hurdles) since his Wolverhampton success in January 2024; this winter's efforts need bettering and he ran poorly when tried in blinkers once in the past.

runners.comment: 0-23 but has shown promise, including C&D; not at her best this winter though
runners.name: Saved Lizzie
runners.spotlight: 23-race maiden; has shown enough ability to think a race of this nature was within her grasp (including C&D) but recent efforts have been underwhelming; stable debut (same owners).

runners.comment: Modest maiden; latest C&D 3rd was a fair run but work to do with runner-up Nicely Curved
runners.name: Spirit Charmer
runners.spotlight: Low-grade maiden but he ran as well as he ever has when third in a similar C&D event 15 days ago (1.5l behind Nicely Curved); wouldn't be sure to be in the same form a second time.

runners.comment: 19-race maiden; needs to step up on recent C&D form to trouble the principals
runners.name: Unknown Journey
runners.spotlight: 0-19; fair third in a C&D handicap on his penultimate start but finished 5.5l behind First Encounter here last time; wait for an elusive first success set to continue.

runners.comment: Landed gamble here in December and subsequent 2nd is strong form; still well handicapped
runners.name: Watermelon Sugar
runners.spotlight: Landed a gamble over C&D in December and found only a subsequent winner too strong back here last month (remote third also won next time out); still well handicapped.

runners.breeder: Saleh Al Homaizi & Imad Al Sagar
runners.comment: Capable at this level but this is his first 6f run since October 2021; likely best watched
runners.name: Split Elevens
runners.spotlight: Usually seen over 7f or 1m; on a handy mark on last year's best but he finished down the field here 17 days ago and could prove vulnerable back sprinting.

runners.comment: Yet to fire for current stable and arrives with more to prove than most
runners.name: Stapleford Park
runners.spotlight: Yet to fire for current stable; dropping down the weights but vulnerable in a useful race of its type.

runners.comment: 14-race maiden but conditions no problem and 1lb lower than for last week's narrow defeat
runners.name: Dark Sun
runners.spotlight: 0-14 but she has been threatening this year, finishing second over C&D last month and narrowly beaten at Wolverhampton last week; able to race off a 1lb lower mark here and commands respect.

runners.comment: Two wins for new yard this winter, the latest here (7f) two weeks ago; still on fair mark
runners.name: Profit Street
runners.spotlight: Two wins, the latest over 7f here two weeks ago (second and third run in the 3.12), and several solid placed efforts for his new stable this winter; unlikely to be too far away once again.

runners.comment: Well in on old form; ran well on stable debut; slow away/always behind on Monday's return
runners.name: Running Cool
runners.spotlight: Thrown in on his Irish form from 2023; struggled for Tim Easterby in 2024/25 but he was a good second at Wolverhampton on his stable debut last September; missed the break and never in contention on his return to action on Monday; bit to prove after that but the ability is there.

runners.comment: 1m winner; fair 3rd over 5f when last seen ten weeks ago; market to guide on stable debut
runners.name: Just Jump
runners.spotlight: Won a 1m maiden claimer (soft) at Bellewstown in October, his only win from 17 starts in Ireland; stayed on for a close third in a 5f handicap at Dundalk ten weeks ago; starts out for Tony Carroll in a useful event for the grade but he is well worth a market check.

runners.comment: C&D winner off 1lb higher in October; mixed since but remains capable at this level
runners.name: Harry Brown
runners.owner: Peter Crate And Gallagher Bloodstock Ltd
runners.spotlight: C&D winner off a 1lb higher mark in October; in and out since but he remains capable at this level.

runners.comment: Solid runs in defeat since a 6f Kempton win in October; each-way claims again
runners.name: Southbank
runners.spotlight: Ready win at Kempton (6f) in October; solid efforts in defeat since and this mark isn't beyond him; each-way shout once again.

runners.comment: Seen to advantage but form of breakthrough win looks alright; claims up 4lb
runners.name: Electrocution
runners.spotlight: Helped by being held up in a strongly run race when off the mark at Wolverhampton 23 days ago (7f) but the form looks alright as the second has filled the same position twice since; claims up 4lb.

runners.comment: Went the wrong way for Archie Watson and changed hands for just 2,200gns in September
runners.name: Private Project
runners.spotlight: Went the wrong way for Archie Watson and changed hands for just 2,200gns in September; looks best watched on AW debut.

runners.comment: Landed some nice bets at Lingfield last month; possible excuses since
runners.name: Giles Glory
runners.spotlight: Landed some nice bets off the back of a gelding operation/break at Lingfield last month (7f); new trip then new surface might have been his undoing since and he looks worth another chance with Cieren Fallon back aboard; tongue-tie and visor selected.

runners.comment: Can be more amenable back over 7f here and give a better account of himself
runners.name: Telling Time
runners.spotlight: Overraced in front when stepped up to 8.6f for handicap debut at Wolverhampton this month, eventually weakening into ninth of ten; can be more amenable back over 7f here and give a better account of himself.

runners.breeder: S A R L Haras De Dodville
runners.comment: Found just a subsequent winner too strong on handicap debut; obvious claims off same mark
runners.name: Hove Ranger
runners.spotlight: Found just a subsequent winner too strong on handicap debut at Lingfield six weeks ago (1m; 10-1; still looked green); obvious claims off the same mark.

runners.comment: Similar profile to Telling Time; more severe headgear is reached for
runners.name: Hamish Leek
runners.spotlight: Started a similar price to Telling Time when also stepped up to 8.6f for handicap debut at Wolverhampton this month and achieved a similar amount (soundly beaten in seventh); blinkers replace cheekpieces here.

runners.breeder: Mr & Mrs J Davis & P Mitchell BStock
runners.comment: Yet to get within 7l of scoring; drawn widest for this step up in trip/return
runners.name: Starakova
runners.owner: Howard Bolly Sutton Molony Weller Cowles
runners.spotlight: Half-sister to five winners but is yet to get within 7l of scoring; drawn widest for this step up in trip/return; yard form and the booking of Rossa Ryan offer some hope.

runners.comment: Down the field in all five handicap starts and he's hard to fancy
runners.name: Grand Echo
runners.spotlight: Down the field in all five handicap starts and he's hard to fancy.

runners.comment: Chance to build on minor promise shown last time in this 0-55 handicap
runners.name: Saturday Again
runners.spotlight: Her half-sister Thursday won twice for this yard; back from a break and showed more in a first-time hood (retained) at Lingfield last time (sent off 200-1); this modest handicap looks much more suitable.

runners.comment: Yet to make the frame and another struggle looks likely
runners.name: Lady Birgma
runners.spotlight: Yet to make the frame and another struggle looks likely.

runners.comment: Started triple-figure odds in all but one of her seven starts and has run accordingly
runners.name: Dawn Melody
runners.spotlight: Started triple-figure odds in all but one of her seven starts and has run accordingly; moves up in trip.

runners.comment: Yet to beat more than two home in a race
runners.name: Bosh Soldier
runners.spotlight: Beat a total of five home in as many starts for George Boughey and trailed in last when starting out for Tony Carroll at Chelmsford recently.

17:40.race_name: Try Unibet's New Improved Acca Boosts Novice Stakes

runners.comment: Winner in Ireland last year; offloaded for just 8,000gns; might struggle to defy penalty
runners.name: Marlborough Place
runners.spotlight: Built on pleasing debut for Adrian Murray when sticking to the far rail and just holding on at Limerick last time (1m); offloaded by Amo Racing for just 8,000gns in his time off and gelded too; might struggle to defy a 7lb penalty.

runners.comment: Pleasing start for Thomas Faulkner at Southwell in December (1m); could step up
runners.name: Pulsar Star
runners.spotlight: Bang there over a furlong out and did best of the bigger-priced runners at the line when starting out for Thomas Faulkner at Southwell in December (1m); could step up in returning cheekpieces.

runners.comment: Good second here two weeks ago; fancied to cope with this drop in trip
runners.name: Ablon
runners.owner: Mrs C Fruhbeck and Denford Stud
runners.spotlight: Had no answer when the heavily backed favourite loomed large over 1m here two weeks ago but she was attempting to give him a stone and did well to stick on for second; fancied to cope with this drop in trip.

runners.comment: Her yard going through a purple patch boosts hopes of a winning return
runners.name: Cosi Bear
runners.spotlight: Stepped up on debut effort when going down narrowly at Southwell 503 days ago (also 7f); her yard going through a purple patch boosts hopes of a winning return.

runners.comment: Still looked green at Lingfield 15 days ago; likely has more to offer
runners.name: Holly Mist
runners.spotlight: Hooded both starts; went down by two necks on debut at Redcar in September and still looked green when managing 1l second of three on reappearance at Lingfield recently (also 7f); likely has more to offer.

runners.comment: Second then first at the track of late; solid claims up 3lb
runners.name: Popmaster
runners.spotlight: Signalled his turn was near when going down by a neck over C&D in January and turned the tables on his conqueror when scoring over a furlong further here three weeks ago (well ridden; Nikovo back in third); solid claims up 3lb.

runners.comment: Went close on last season's comeback and market informative on AW debut
runners.name: God Of War
runners.spotlight: Too keen out in front when last seen but was in winning form at Sandown the time before (also 7f); went close on last season's comeback and market informative on AW debut.

runners.comment: Handicapper is giving him a chance and he has plenty in his favour here
runners.name: Kingdom Come
runners.spotlight: Goes well fresh and should cope if it gets tactical given all three of his C&D wins were achieved in single-figure fields; pushing two years since he last got his head in front but the handicapper is giving him a chance and he responded well to first-time cheekpieces (retained here) when fifth over track and trip last time; of significant interest.

runners.comment: Two good runs from two this year but a tactical affair over 7f wouldn't suit
runners.name: Nikovo
runners.spotlight: Two good runs from two this year, doing best of the hold-up horses when two places behind Popmaster over 1m here three weeks ago; might not be as equipped as that runner to cope with what could be a tactical affair over a furlong shorter here.

runners.breeder: S A S Haute Vallee & Charlotte Hutchinso
runners.comment: Very good second to kick off 2026; this is tougher but he's in receipt of plenty of weight
runners.name: Brunel Nation
runners.owner: R Lane L Watson & J Langridge
runners.spotlight: Last season was a bit of a write-off but his first start of 2026 at Lingfield five weeks ago was very good (he went down by just a neck); this is tougher but he's in receipt of plenty of weight from his four rivals.

18:40.race_name: Try Unibet's New Smartview Racecards Handicap (London Mile Series Qualifier)

runners.comment: Handicapper probably has her measure but showing up well for a long way wouldn't surprise
runners.name: Tronido
runners.spotlight: Made all or virtually all for four career wins; handicapper probably has her measure now but she should at least be able to revert to her favoured tactics blessed with a good draw and with the freshness having been taken out of her last time.

runners.comment: Hard to make a case for, particularly over this trip of 1m
runners.name: Pursuit Of Truth
runners.spotlight: Changed hands for 9,000gns after winning at Wolverhampton last summer (9.4f; left Kevin Philippart De Foy); low-key stable debut over 1m3f here in November (33-1) and this might not be enough of a test back from another break.

runners.comment: Twice managed third over C&D despite being unwanted in the betting; yard since hit form
runners.name: I Am Me
runners.spotlight: Sole win came on British debut last April (1m1f turf); not with Mike Murphy, who has hit form since this one last ran, long and twice managed third over C&D despite being unwanted in the betting; could be the answer from handy draw.

runners.comment: Lurks on a dangerous mark and the booking of Rossa Ryan could bode well
runners.name: Rhythm N Rock
runners.spotlight: Gamble went astray, but only just, over C&D in December; not so effective over further at Wolverhampton since but he lurks on a dangerous mark and the booking of Rossa Ryan, who is 5-23 for the yard, could bode well; draw not ideal.

runners.comment: Key player off the same mark as when comfortably landing a division of this last year
runners.name: Top Of The Class
